title: Trillion Dollar Words: A New Financial Dataset, Task & Market Analysis
venue: ACL 2023 (Proceedings of the 61st Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics, Vol 1: Long Papers, pp. 6664–6679)
notes: Verified ACL Anthology paper identifier is 2023.acl-long.368 (DOI: 10.18653/v1/2023.acl-long.368). Authors are Agam Shah, Suvan Paturi (spelling corrected from Sujit), and Sudheer Chava. Primary source for FOMC hawkish/neutral/dovish ground truth.

title: Temporal Leakage in Financial News NLP: A Multi-Architecture Audit with a Regime-Specific M&A Signal
venue: arXiv preprint / under review (committed to EMNLP 2026)
notes: Verified arXiv ID is 2608.17223 (published August 2026, corrected from 2608.06450). Audited across 16 feature-model pipelines showing random splits inflate performance metrics (MCC) by 1.1x to 6.5x due to temporal leakage.

title: Mind the Shift: Decoding Monetary Policy Stance from FOMC Statements with Large Language Models
notes: Verified arXiv ID is 2603.14313 (March 15, 2026, corrected from 2603.02987). Code repository is yixuantt/DeltaConsistentScoring. Method: Delta-Consistent Scoring (DCS) using frozen LLM representations to capture inter-meeting monetary stance shifts.

title: All Leaks Count, Some Count More: Interpretable Temporal Contamination Detection and Mitigation in LLM Backtesting
notes: Verified arXiv ID is 2602.17234 (corrected from 2502.16450). Authors: Zeyu Zhang, Ryan Chen, Bradly C. Stadie (corrected from Y. Sun et al.). Proposes Shapley-DCLR (metric) and TimeSPEC (Time-Supervised Prediction with Extracted Claims, inference-time architecture).

title: Look-Ahead-Bench: a Standardized Benchmark of Look-ahead Bias in Point-in-Time LLMs for Finance
notes: Verified author is Mostapha Benhenda (GitHub user 'benstaf', corrected from Benjamin Staf). Benchmark measuring alpha decay between in-sample and out-of-sample periods to evaluate look-ahead bias in LLM financial time series forecasting.

title: FinBERT: Financial Sentiment Analysis with Pre-trained Language Models
notes: Distinct from Huang et al. (2023). Dogu Araci's 2019 FinBERT fine-tuned BERT-base on Financial PhraseBank with a pre-2019 cutoff.

title: FinBERT: A Large Language Model for Extracting Information from Financial Text
notes: Distinct from Araci (2019). Pre-trained on corporate 10-Ks, 10-Qs, and conference call transcripts by Huang, Wang & Yang (HKUST).

title: Financial Statement Analysis with Large Language Models
venue: University of Chicago Booth School of Business Research Paper / SSRN
notes: Evaluates GPT-4 on financial statement analysis and forward earnings direction prediction; analyzes whether LLM forecasts exploit memorization.

title: Shortcut Learning in Deep Neural Networks
notes: Foundational conceptual framework explaining how deep neural networks latch onto spurious unintended correlations (shortcuts) rather than intended semantic competence.
